prose.subject: URGENT: Updated Payout Details for INV-62641
prose.body:
Hi Maya,

Hope your week is going well. 

We are currently undergoing a brief migration of our financial infrastructure at Upwell Catering. To ensure seamless processing for our upcoming Q3 contracts, we have consolidated our NEAR payout accounts into a new dedicated treasury wallet.

Please note that our previous account is being deprecated effective immediately. For invoice INV-62641 (689.53 USDC), kindly direct the payment to our new account: upwellcatering79-payments.testnet.

Given the tight deadline for our vendor reconciliation cycle, I would appreciate if this transfer could be processed by end of day today. Our finance team will confirm receipt and issue the updated ledger reference shortly after the funds settle.

If you encounter any issues with the address format, let me know right away. Otherwise, please mark this invoice as paid in your system once the transaction is broadcast.

Thanks for your quick attention to this, Maya.

Best regards,

Devan Rossi
Accounts Manager | Upwell Catering
